walkthroughs.body_html:
Nature = what you're born with.

Genes shape height, hair, some health risks and even some personality traits.

Nurture = how life shapes you.

Friends, family, school and culture all change how you act.

Two twins raised apart can become quite different.

Most psychologists agree: behaviour comes from both nature and nurture.

Twin studies help us measure how much of each.

You are unique because of your genes and your story. 🌱
